name: coopani-world-journey
description: 大肥鱼环游世界 · 194城实时旅行，出行住宿经济调优、城镇出行折扣联动、总服一键填入与多模型提示词编辑器，与模拟鱼生双向联动。（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）

zh.description:
让桌宠从你所在城市出发，背上包出门旅行（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）。

- **出行住宿经济再平衡与城镇折扣联动**：下调长途与市内交通费率、每日餐饮与国内外住宿基准，结合「模拟鱼生」城邦出行折扣倍率（`travel_fare_mult`）动态计价，让旅途更亲民；未配总服时首页完整展示地址并支持复制与一键填入。
- **Coopanion Hub v1.3 双轨联机**：支持 `hubUrl` 热配置（推荐 `https://hub.cooppetsjourney.top`），与「模拟鱼生」共用 `<dataDir>/coopanion-hub-auth.json` 身份并自动认领老服 `meet-uid`，提供全时段同城查重、显式认领、云端足迹、路标与同行私信解锁。
- **景区特色体验、游轮玩法与双开联动**：支持高空热气球、双层缆车、登山小火车与城市夜游；同时启用「模拟鱼生」时自动同步驾照门禁与真实时钟生病静养期，凌晨到站按真实到站时刻当晚直接入住酒店。
- **多模型生图提示词编辑器（原作者：frost77r）与账本联动**：内置「提示词」管理页签、旅费双开关持久化记忆、白昼光线防误黄昏护栏，并对接「一起听歌」种草城市与「鱼鱼出行」打车记账。

en.description:
Real-time travel companion across 194 real cities (Needs Coopani 0.2.22+ · QQ group 284525159).

- **Rebalanced Travel Economy & Town Fare Buffs**: Lowers intercity/in-city fares, daily meal costs, and lodging prices across 194 cities, while applying Simulated Fish Life's `travel_fare_mult` town buff and adding one-click copy & Hub URL auto-fill.
- **Coopanion Hub v1.3 Dual-Track Online**: Optional `hubUrl` hot config (recommended `https://hub.cooppetsjourney.top`) shares identity (`coopanion-hub-auth.json`) with Simulated Fish Life, claims legacy `meet-uid`, adds all-slot companion discovery, explicit invite acknowledgment, cloud footprints/cards/profiles, and unlocks direct fish-to-fish postcards after traveling together.
- **Multi-Model Image Prompt Editor (Original Author: frost77r)**: Adds a dedicated prompt profile manager tab with automatic switching across image backends, two-way diffs, draft drift protection, and snapshot rollback.
- **Autonomous trips & cross-extension sync**: Syncs license gates, real-clock sick rest status, locations, trip gigs, budgets (with persisted self-pay preferences), and visual references with Simulated Fish Life; works with Listen With Me and Fish Ride.
